prior_observation_disclosure: Musashi's independent post-hoc diagnostic values were ALREADY OBSERVED before this contract existed (information-matched pooled skills +0.023177 h6 / +0.021533 h12; scale-only +0.022736 / +0.021161; incremental lags +0.000441 / +0.000372; near-zero conditional direction skill; <3% same-bar collisions). This audit REPRODUCES them with the executing package on the frozen arrays — it can confirm attribution on development rows and nothing more. No value from the order is copied as authority; every number is recomputed.

data_binding.role_geometry: the N2 ledger geometry verbatim (four score windows w1-w4 of 216 rows, embargo 3, cal 176, fit prefix); no role, target, feature or score row may be added
data_binding.collision_mask_rule: a sensitivity METADATA mask (not a feature, not a target): same-bar collision at horizon h iff the first upper-hit bar equals the first lower-hit bar and precedes h, derived from the contract's exact validated OHLC, levels and trailing scale; self-check: every collision row inside h must carry label 1 (adverse-first) in the frozen npz

arms_equal_information.note: every fitted arm uses the census machinery: hyperparameter on CALIBRATION only, refit on fit+calibration, fit-only standardization — so no arm sees information another is denied
arms_equal_information.arm1_prior_fitcal: class prior estimated on fit+calibration rows (closes F1: the recency-matched baseline)
arms_equal_information.arm2_scale_only: multinomial logistic on the current barrier scale (barscale lag 0, 1 feature)
arms_equal_information.arm3_scale_lags: multinomial logistic on barscale lags 0-3 (4 features) — the N2 winning model
arms_equal_information.arm4_summary_only: multinomial logistic on the fixed 249-value causal summary of the 83 inputs
arms_equal_information.arm5_scale_plus_summary: multinomial logistic on barscale lags 0-3 concatenated with the 249-value summary (253 features)

metrics.primary: multiclass log loss (probabilities clipped 1e-12); NO hard accuracy as a primary metric
metrics.decomposition: exact additive split L_multi = L_hit_vs_censored + L_direction_given_hit, using p_hit = p0+p1 and p(class|hit) = p_class/p_hit; the binary hit-vs-censored log loss scores every row; the conditional direction log loss scores only rows with a hit label
secondary: Brier score and per-class Brier components
per-class recall of the argmax classifier (exploratory only)
class support per role and window
calibration tables: deciles of predicted hit probability vs empirical hit frequency per window
metrics.paired: per-observation multiclass log-loss differences for every predeclared contrast

contrasts_and_decision.uncertainty: within-window circular block bootstrap on per-observation differences, block 6, B=2000, seed 606, one-sided H1 mean>0; minimum Monte Carlo p reported as <= 1/2001; Holm across the eight contrasts via agent_plugins.paired_inference.holm_adjust

margins.rationale: half and a quarter of the N2 materiality 0.02: the audit asks whether SMALL incremental structure exists beyond the target-definition scalar

contrasts_and_decision.skill_definition: 1 - sum(loss_arm_a)/sum(loss_arm_b) pooled over the four score windows; per-window skills also reported

verdict_rule.BARRIER_SIGNAL_EXPLAINED_BY_TARGET_DEFIN: arm2 beats arm1 on both targets (pooled skill >= 0.01, all four windows positive, Holm p < 0.05) AND no incremental contrast (arm3-arm2 or arm5-arm2, either target) simultaneously has all windows positive, pooled skill >= 0.005 and Holm p < 0.05
verdict_rule.INCREMENTAL_DEVELOPMENT_STRUCTURE_OBSERV: any incremental contrast (arm3-arm2 or arm5-arm2, either target) has all windows positive, pooled skill >= 0.005 and Holm p < 0.05
verdict_rule.ATTRIBUTION_INCONCLUSIVE: anything else, including any degenerate fit, non-finite loss, or failed self-check
verdict_rule.labels_scope: development evidence only; no label can promote a model

sensitivities_exploratory: recompute every contrast excluding same-bar-collision rows from scoring
recompute every bootstrap p at block lengths 3, 6 and 12
all sensitivity outputs labeled exploratory, outside the verdict rule

execution.determinism: single process, fixed seed 606 for the bootstrap, deterministic solvers
execution.output_artifact: TARGET_HORIZON_CENSUS_N2_ATTRIBUTION_AUDIT_2026_09_04.json, written only after this contract is committed and pushed
